text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A suspect has appeared in court after his arrest for allegedly trying to cash a cheque which vanished from the government's Central Payments Office. Four cheques with a face value of almost Z$2 million have disappeared from the office.
- A wave of countrywide strikes hit the construction, clothing, cement and lime industries on Tuesday as workers downed tools demanding more pay and improved working conditions.
- Police have caught more than 6,000 motorists for breaking traffic laws since they began an operation last week.
